rationale: Two shared public-US EPUB hydration canonical SQL writes are replaced by an authenticated fixed private QA legal-owner command. The private owner checks current source copyright, approval and territory conditions, exact Gutenberg-to-edition/EPUB-asset-version binding, bounded R2 bytes, full EPUB archive validity and SHA-256. Two guarded primary D1 writes execute atomically and cannot be redirected by shared callers. The nine surviving canonical API SQL sites retain exact SQL/function/operation/disposition with new whole-file SHA fingerprints. This is not production certification; independent paid-rights and rollback release gates remain blocked.

files.review: Two exact shared US EPUB hydration SQL sites removed after private byte-verified owner replacement. Nine surviving protected API SQL sites independently re-fingerprinted with original function/SQL identities.
